headline: CONTRA loops like the arcade — stage 1 comes back faster
lede: Clear the gate and the jungle does not roll credits: it rebuilds at LOOP 2 with a spare life and a hotter cadence, and keeps raising the heat one notch per pass up to x1.30. The tuning was proven against the harness, not guessed — the first cut sped up bullets and the honest autopilot proved that broke the hop law.

notes.text: #2894 shipped: STAGE CLEAR resumes stage 1 at loop n — score, gun and seed carry, the shared bank pays +1 life (to five), and soldier/turret/sniper/depot/cannon rearms, the door spill, the nade cadence, the walker pace, the shutter cycle and courier traffic all run at loopK (x1.00 + 0.10/pass, pinned x1.30).

Round speeds and the torrent stay pinned: the lane-aim law says a hop answers every aimed round, and the hop window is tuned to those flight paths — the loop compresses flight time, never paths. Every loop still clears 12/12 seeds under the honest autopilot; loop 1 is byte-identical to the old game.

contracheck grew 8 loop pins and 2 live legs (171 total) plus two named mutants — loop-dead (a placebo round two) and loop-overdrive (heat escaping the clamp) — 16/16 named. The gold LOOP n HUD readout is pinned against a toggle baseline.

Same shift, other slot: DOUBLE DRAGON's kidnapping opening (#2891) and first-timer pass (#2874) shipped. Next for CONTRA: the loop deserves cabinet-era presentation — banner, heat palette, sound escalation (#2902, filed).
